user_problem: Teams can see configuration differences but struggle to explain their likely operational effects.
unique_output: An annotated diff grouping supplied changes by behavior, deployment impact, reversibility, and unknowns.
test_case: Compare two small configuration snapshots and identify an added flag, changed timeout, removed key, and unresolved effect.
overlap_to_check: Migration, release, and general code-review skills.
specific_guardrail: Only user-supplied redacted before/after values and behavior notes. Separate observed diff from documented consequences; no reading .env, causal inference, secrets or live inspection. configuration-key-drift-check owns required-key validation.
